rows.what_the_ink_shows: The header crop shows n° 574 and underlined 300 exemplaires. The order crop shows Fascicule 0, Recto verso, Page de garde, Lettre L 1 à L 43, Table des Matières T 1 : T 10, instructions to print its last three pages with fascicule 4, and Introduction (i à cxxii). The separate blue-name crop shows LACAN. These copying directions are already present in the original’s separately marked reused right half.
rows.note: The original already captures the reproduction-order material, so no textual edit is needed. L1097.R1 limits the local refinement to document type: the right panel is a copying/assembly order listing a table of contents, not itself a mathematical contents outline. The scan alone does not verify identification with Récoltes et Semailles, the edition’s date/structure, or every part of the external H12 claim; those bibliographic claims remain unverified here. Existing uncertainties, including the smaller copy count, are preserved.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Viewed the full sheet and three enlarged contrast crops. Confirmed the job number, 300-copy instruction, duplex instruction, section list/page ranges, fascicule-4 printing instruction, and LACAN name already represented in the original. No external edition or work identity was checked.

events.type: refuted, with the refined statement's id
events.outcome: L1097.R1 refines/refutes only classification of the right panel itself as a mathematical contents outline: its visible text is a reproduction order listing a contents section. It does not establish or refute a specific publication identity, edition date, or mathematical claim.
